collection.description: A villager lies awake thinking about everything at once, until the frogs start singing.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: It's late. Everyone in (name1)'s hut is asleep except (name1). (He/She) is thinking about everything at once: whether the roof will hold if it rains, whether (he/she) said the wrong thing at dinner, whether the stars are the same stars that (his/her) grandparents looked at, whether anyone else ever lies awake like this. Somewhere outside, a frog starts singing. Then another. Then about forty more. (name1) gives up on the big questions, laughs quietly into the dark, and listens to the frogs until morning.
